title: pluggable-reauth-hooks-and-typed-stream-adapters
author: Ishaan Patel
description: Introduce a pluggable reauthentication hook and a small, strongly typed streaming adapter for the Go SDK to improve cross-SDK parity with Python/TS, reduce auth edge-case retries, and make streaming ergonomics easier for consumers. This PR implements a lightweight ReauthProvider interface that callers can implement to provide proactive token refresh, an optional background lease-renewal goroutine for long-lived streams, and a typed StreamAdapter that emits rich events (Chunk/Heartbeat/Resume) instead of raw io chunks. Motivation: teams saw intermittent 401 surface during long-running chat sessions and awkward retry semantics when token rotation happened mid-stream; the goal is to give Go integrators the same control surface already available in other SDKs while keeping the default UX simple (no-op provider). This change is opt-in: existing consumers keep current behavior unless they pass a non-nil ReauthProvider when creating a client or stream. The PR includes a cross-repo contract test harness snapshot (tests/contract/stream-reauth.json) used locally in CI and a bump to go-sdk v1.6.0. Note: parts of the implementation intentionally decouple reauth triggers from the backoff scheduler to allow site-specific token refresh strategies (KMS, delegated tokens, STS).
commits: feat(reauth): add ReauthProvider interface and default no-op implementation
feat(stream): typed StreamAdapter with Chunk/Heartbeat/Resume events and convenience iterators
chore(ci): add contract harness snapshot and test runner script for local iteration
fix(auth): avoid double-refresh race when token refresh is already in progress
docs: usage examples and migration notes for ReauthProvider and StreamAdapter
review_comments: Maya Thompson: Nice separation of concerns. Question: can we expose a context cancellation signal to the ReauthProvider so it can abort long-running refresh calls?
Ishaan Patel: Good call. Added ctx parameter to ReauthProvider.Refresh(ctx) in second commit and updated callers to propagate stream contexts.
Luca Romano: I saw a flaky test on CI for the heartbeat timer, added a suggestion to use a deterministic clock in tests.
Ishaan Patel: Updated adapter_test.go to inject a fake clock; helps stabilize CI and local runs.
Priya Desai: Documented migration notes and called out that default behavior is unchanged unless ReauthProvider is provided. Approving after docs update.
release_notes: Added opt-in ReauthProvider for proactive token rotation, typed StreamAdapter that surfaces heartbeat/resume events, improved stream ergonomics, fixed double-refresh race, bumped go-sdk to v1.6.0.
